36 weeks + 7 days = 36*7 + 7 = 259 days.  
Add 259 days to 1203-03-07.  
1203 is not a leap year (divisible by 3 but not by 400 or 4? Actually 1203 mod 4 = 3, so not leap).  
From March 7: 259 days later → March 24 days left (31-7=24) → April 30 → May 31 → June 30 → July 31 → Aug 31 → Sep 30 → Oct 31 → Nov 30.  
Sum: 24+30+31+30+31+31+30+31+30 = 258 days brings to Nov 30, plus 1 more day → Dec 1, 1203.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1203-12-01
